# BonzAI 4.1.0

- Add OpenRouter inference, media routing and streaming alongside local and peer inference.
- Expand Smart Workflows with media production teams, CMMS casework, agent services and team handoffs.
- Improve the game editor, playtesting, roleplay journeys and generation history.
- Improve tokenization previews, themed artwork, wallet dialogs and protocol recovery interfaces.
- Add Qwen Image 2.1 Standard and Turbo generation/editing pipelines and adapter support.
- Coordinate local inference across text, media, workflows and training, with visible queues and scoped cancellation.
- Improve music memory admission, streamed execution, lyrics generation and duration estimation.
- Improve training/export reliability, translations and cross-platform runtime packaging.

Local creation and workflows remain available without wallet or workspace payments.
Optional onchain features require operator-supplied deployed contract configuration.

Platform signing and validated installer download links will be recorded after native build validation.
